facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 9 April 2025 adopted the texts for an electronic information and management system for public procurement (commande publique), which the government is putting in place; ministers were instructed to ensure their application.
facts.system: Systeme d'information et de gestion electronique de la commande publique

systems.system: Systeme d'information et de gestion electronique de la commande publique

BEN.note: Nothing on civil servant digital training.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 9 April 2025 adopted a decree sending to the National Assembly for examination and vote a bill amending law 2017-08 of 19 June 2017 on the identification of natural persons in Benin.
facts.system: Loi 2017-08 portant identification des personnes physiques (amendment bill)

BEN.note: The e-foncier platform is named only as a platform whose users' responsibility the new decree clarifies; processing of land transactions is not stated.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 9 April 2025 states that the review of decree 2023-684 shows the city of Cotonou fully covered by the national cadastre through collective registration; a new decree replacing it aims at covering the whole national territory.

BEN.note: Nothing on local government office connection.
